clips.title: The story
paras: Webwinder Path is a winding mountainous road in the Stonetalon Mountains connecting the troll outpost of Malaka'jin to Mirkfallon Lake. It cuts through rugged crags and dense highland woods inhabited by aggressive arachnids and native beasts.

Running from the Horde settlement of Malaka'jin toward Mirkfallon Lake, Webwinder Path serves as one of the primary roadways carving through the lower Stonetalon Mountains. True to its name, the route is notorious for the thick cobwebs strung high among the canopy and jagged cliff sides. Travelers along this winding stretch must constantly watch their step, sharing the beaten path with prowling mountain spiders, aggressive thunder lizards, and territorial rams.
